name: Simple Todo App
description:
A basic todo list web application with the following features:

1. Users can create, read, update, and delete todo items
2. Each todo has a title, description, and completion status
3. Todos are persisted in a database
4. Simple REST API for all operations
5. Basic web UI to interact with todos
6. User authentication (login/logout)
7. Users can only see their own todos
notes: Should include CRUD operations, auth, and basic UI components
